name: BART API
tagline: Real-time Bay Area Rapid Transit schedules, advisories, and estimates
description: Public API for San Francisco Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) providing schedules, real-time departure estimates, service advisories, station information, and route data. Used by transit apps and developers to access BART system information.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (self-serve registration; demo key available for testing)

use_cases: get real-time departure estimates for a BART station
list all BART stations and their abbreviations
fetch current service advisories and delays
look up station information and elevators
check train arrival times for trip planning
